summary.hiddenNote: The schema has no separate "hidden" state distinct from archived. The only storefront-visibility gate in the codebase is Product.pricingStatus !== 'INACTIVE' (see app/page.tsx, app/api/storefront/search-index/route.ts). There is a noindex boolean but it only affects search-engine indexing, not storefront listing -- every current row has noindex=false. "Archived" above (pricingStatus === INACTIVE) is the only real hidden/excluded state that exists.

vialSizeMapping.rule: 10mL for NAD+ and Glutathione families; 3mL for every other standard product; volume-described products (reconstitution diluents, LC120/LC216) use their own recorded mL size directly.
vialSizeMapping.note: No explicit vialSizeMl field exists on Product in the current schema -- this mapping is applied here as owner-directed manufacturing/label configuration, not read from the database. Not hard-coded into application architecture.
